changeSet.author: exensioreload
changeSet.comment:
Rename pipeline status values to the v3.0 state machine.
Widen status column first: Oracle has VARCHAR(16) which is too narrow for ELASTICSEARCH_MONITORING (24) and COMPLETED_MANUAL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED (40).
Old → New mapping: - pending → STAGED_TO_REFDB - ENQUEUED → QUEUED_FOR_CP - ENRICHMENT → ELASTICSEARCH_MONITORING - ENRICHMENT_TIMEOUT → CP_TIMEOUT - EXENSIO_LOADING → EXENSIO_MONITORING - EXENSIO_TIMEOUT → COMPLETED_MANUAL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED - DONE → COMPLETED - FAILED → CP_FAILED (CP/ES failures) or LOAD_FAILED (Exensio load failures)
FAILED split heuristic: - error_message contains '[ES Failure]', '[pp_log Failure]', 'CP', 'enrichment' → CP_FAILED - error_message contains '[Exensio Failure]', 'Exensio', 'load fail', 'Dead Letter' → LOAD_FAILED - Any remaining FAILED without clear indicator → CP_FAILED (safe default)
changeSet.sql: UPDATE SENDER_STAGE SET status = 'STAGED_TO_REFDB' WHERE status = 'pending'
UPDATE SENDER_STAGE SET status = 'QUEUED_FOR_CP' WHERE status = 'ENQUEUED'
UPDATE SENDER_STAGE SET status = 'ELASTICSEARCH_MONITORING' WHERE status = 'ENRICHMENT'
UPDATE SENDER_STAGE SET status = 'CP_TIMEOUT' WHERE status = 'ENRICHMENT_TIMEOUT'
UPDATE SENDER_STAGE SET status = 'EXENSIO_MONITORING' WHERE status = 'EXENSIO_LOADING'
UPDATE SENDER_STAGE SET status = 'COMPLETED_MANUAL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED' WHERE status = 'EXENSIO_TIMEOUT'
UPDATE SENDER_STAGE SET status = 'COMPLETED' WHERE status = 'DONE'

UPDATE SENDER_STAGE SET status = 'CP_FAILED' WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND (UPPER(error_message) LIKE '%[ES FAILURE]%' OR UPPER(error_message) LIKE '%[PP_LOG FAILURE]%' OR UPPER(error_message) LIKE '%CP%FAILURE%' OR UPPER(error_message) LIKE '%ENRICHMENT%FAIL%' OR UPPER(error_message) LIKE '%[CP %')

UPDATE SENDER_STAGE SET status = 'LOAD_FAILED' WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND (UPPER(error_message) LIKE '%[EXENSIO FAILURE]%' OR UPPER(error_message) LIKE '%[EXENSIO %' OR UPPER(error_message) LIKE '%EXENSIO%FAIL%' OR UPPER(error_message) LIKE '%LOAD FAIL%' OR UPPER(error_message) LIKE '%DEAD LETTER%')
UPDATE SENDER_STAGE SET status = 'CP_FAILED' WHERE status = 'FAILED'

ALTER TABLE SENDER_STAGE ADD CONSTRAINT chk_sender_stage_status CHECK (status IN ( 'DISCOVERED', 'STAGED_TO_REFDB', 'QUEUED_FOR_CP', 'CP_CONSUMED', 'ELASTICSEARCH_MONITORING', 'CP_TIMEOUT', 'EXENSIO_MONITORING', 'COMPLETED_MANUAL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED', 'COMPLETED', 'CP_FAILED', 'LOAD_FAILED', 'CANCELLED' ))

rollback.sql: UPDATE SENDER_STAGE SET status = 'pending' WHERE status = 'STAGED_TO_REFDB'
UPDATE SENDER_STAGE SET status = 'ENQUEUED' WHERE status = 'QUEUED_FOR_CP'
UPDATE SENDER_STAGE SET status = 'ENRICHMENT' WHERE status = 'ELASTICSEARCH_MONITORING'
UPDATE SENDER_STAGE SET status = 'ENRICHMENT_TIMEOUT' WHERE status = 'CP_TIMEOUT'
UPDATE SENDER_STAGE SET status = 'EXENSIO_LOADING' WHERE status = 'EXENSIO_MONITORING'
UPDATE SENDER_STAGE SET status = 'EXENSIO_TIMEOUT' WHERE status = 'COMPLETED_MANUAL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED'
UPDATE SENDER_STAGE SET status = 'DONE' WHERE status = 'COMPLETED'
UPDATE SENDER_STAGE SET status = 'FAILED' WHERE status IN ('CP_FAILED', 'LOAD_FAILED')

ALTER TABLE SENDER_STAGE ADD CONSTRAINT chk_sender_stage_status CHECK (status IN ('pending','ENQUEUED','ENRICHMENT','ENRICHMENT_TIMEOUT','EXENSIO_LOADING','EXENSIO_TIMEOUT','DONE','FAILED','CANCELLED'))
